name: College students should develop a correct view of consumption and consume rationally.
trans: 大学生应树立正确的消费观，理性消费。

name: Making a monthly budget can help us manage living expenses properly and avoid overspending.
trans: 制定每月预算可以帮助我们合理管理生活费，避免超支。

name: We should distinguish needs from wants instead of buying things impulsively.
trans: 我们应该区分需要和想要，而不是冲动购物。

name: Blind comparison may lead to overconsumption and increase the financial burden on parents.
trans: 盲目攀比可能导致过度消费，增加父母的经济负担。

name: It is important to live within one’s means and save money for the future.
trans: 量入为出、为未来存钱很重要。

name: Students should stay away from campus loans and avoid falling into debt.
trans: 学生应远离校园贷，避免陷入债务。

name: When shopping online, we should be cautious about shopping traps and protect our consumer rights.
trans: 网购时，我们应警惕购物陷阱，保护消费者权益。

name: Green consumption means choosing environmentally friendly products and reducing waste.
trans: 绿色消费意味着选择环保产品并减少浪费。

name: We should value quality over brand and spend money on meaningful things.
trans: 我们应重视质量而非品牌，把钱花在有意义的事情上。

name: Taking a part-time job can help students increase income and learn to form good financial habits.
trans: 做兼职可以帮助学生增加收入，并学会养成良好理财习惯。

name: Schools should raise students’ awareness of rational consumption through education.
trans: 学校应通过教育提高学生的理性消费意识。

name: Only by spending money wisely can we enjoy a healthy and stress-free campus life.
trans: 只有明智花钱，我们才能享有健康、无压力的校园生活。

name: It is widely acknowledged that college students should develop a correct view of consumption.
trans: 众所周知，大学生应树立正确的消费观。

name: There is no denying that impulsive buying may cause unnecessary waste and financial pressure.
trans: 不可否认，冲动消费可能造成不必要的浪费和经济压力。

name: As college students, we should make a budget and live within our means.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该制定预算、量入为出。

name: Only by consuming rationally can we avoid falling into debt and reduce the burden on our parents.
trans: 只有理性消费，我们才能避免陷入债务并减轻父母负担。

name: While online shopping brings convenience, we should also be cautious about shopping traps.
trans: 虽然网购带来便利，但我们也应警惕购物陷阱。

name: Developing good financial habits enables us to spend money wisely and plan for the future.
trans: 养成良好理财习惯使我们能够明智花钱并为未来做规划。
